Free arena FPS. The download is one file of about a megabyte. It runs fast.

Every match builds a brand new arena. Nothing ever repeats. There are no spawns to memorize and no
angles to learn. Map knowledge was taken out of the game on purpose. What decides a fight is your
movement and your gunplay.

Everyone spawns with the same two guns. A fast rifle and a sniper that kills in one shot. No
unlocks, no loadouts, no pickups, no SBMM, no anticheat driver. You can slide and you can lean.

Maps, guns, sounds and animation are all generated by code when the game starts. There are no asset
files. That is why the whole game is one small download with no installer, no launcher and no
account.

Servers run at 120 ticks. The server rewinds time to the moment you fired, so your shots land where
you saw them. Any Linux copy can host one.

Solo dev, and this is an experiment. Do not take it too seriously.

**Windows**

Download `skill-issue.exe` and run it.

The game is new and unsigned, so you get two warnings. Your browser asks first. Click Keep. Windows
asks on first launch. Click More info, then Run anyway. Nothing is installed. The exe is the whole
game.

**Linux and Steam Deck**

Download `skill-issue-linux`. Your browser removes its permission to run, so put it back.

```sh
chmod +x ./skill-issue-linux
./skill-issue-linux
```

You need Ubuntu 23.10 or newer, Debian 13 or newer, Fedora 39 or newer, Arch, or SteamOS 3.7 or
newer.

**Updates**

The game updates itself on the start screen. It never interrupts a match. Your old copy is kept next
to the new one with a `.old` name. Set `update_check 0` in `config.cfg` to switch it off.
`SHA256SUMS` lets you verify your download.
